title: Corin the Little Seahorse and the Evening Reef Song
description: A little apricot seahorse and a tiny silver fish listen to the gentle evening song of their coral reef, then settle to sleep in their cozy reef nook.

Corin.color: Warm apricot-orange with a pale buttery-peach belly and muzzle, a cream five-point star on his left cheek, and three pale coral-pink spots on the outer back of his neck
Corin.bodyShape: Baby seahorse about twice Ebi height, with a rounded forehead, short tubular snout, plump curved belly, tiny translucent dorsal fin, two small side fins, and a neatly curled prehensile tail; no arms, hands, or clothing
Corin.face: Large dark espresso-brown eyes with tiny white catchlights and a gentle smile

Ebi.role: Supporting character; a tiny silver fish
Ebi.color: Pearl-silver body with a powder-blue back, clean white belly, and a single muted lavender teardrop patch behind her right eye
Ebi.bodyShape: Tiny oval fish about half Corin height, with a rounded nose, one small dorsal fin, two side fins, and a softly forked tail; no arms, hands, or clothing
Ebi.face: Wide dark charcoal eyes with minimal white catchlights and a small smiling mouth

settingBible.Evening Coral Reef: A sheltered tropical reef with a C-shaped peach-pink coral arch, jade sea-grass bed, bubble column, three mauve anemones, a cream shell-shaped stone, a sandy clearing, and a winding sage sea-grass path
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded ocean animals, golden evening fading to moonlit blue, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Corin stays apricot-orange with a cream left-cheek star and three neck spots.
Ebi stays smaller pearl-silver with a lavender teardrop behind her right eye and first appears on page 4.
Pages 13–15 keep Corin on the left coral stem and Ebi in the right sea-grass bed.
No rescue, danger, instruments, or written music symbols.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: As the evening ocean turned golden, Corin the little seahorse swayed beside his favorite coral garden.
pages.illustrationScene: Little apricot seahorse Corin sways beside his favorite coral garden as the evening ocean turns golden.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Corin: apricot-orange, peach belly, cream star on LEFT cheek, three pale spots on neck back. Ebi absent.

pages.text: He listened to the bubbles rising through the sea grass, making a soft plip-plip-plip.
pages.illustrationScene: Corin listens alone to bubbles rising through the sea grass with a soft plip-plip-plip.
pages.continuityNotes: Corin alone by bubble column and sea grass.

pages.text: A gentle current brushed the coral branches, and Corin heard a whispery shhh.
pages.illustrationScene: A gentle current brushes coral branches while Corin alone hears a whispery shhh.
pages.continuityNotes: Corin alone listening beside coral branches.

pages.text: His friend Ebi, a tiny silver fish, swam over and asked what made Corin smile.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny silver fish Ebi swims over from the right and asks what made Corin smile.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Ebi: pearl-silver fish, powder-blue back, lavender teardrop behind RIGHT eye; half Corin height.

pages.text: “The reef is singing,” Corin said, and together they listened to the bubbly, swishy tune.
pages.illustrationScene: Corin says the reef is singing, and together they listen to the bubbly swishy tune.

pages.text: They floated past three round sea anemones whose waving tips moved to the music.
pages.illustrationScene: They float past three round mauve sea anemones whose waving tips move to the music.
pages.continuityNotes: Exactly three mauve anemones on flat beige rock.

pages.text: Near a smooth shell-shaped stone, little pebbles clicked softly as the water rolled by.
pages.illustrationScene: Near a smooth cream shell-shaped stone, little pebbles click softly as water rolls by.

pages.text: Ebi flicked her tail in time, but Corin only twirled once in a slow, happy circle.
pages.illustrationScene: Ebi flicks her tail in time while Corin twirls once in a slow happy circle.
pages.continuityNotes: Still at shell-stone area; one modest twirl.

pages.text: Above the reef, the last warm sunlight faded into a calm lavender-blue glow.
pages.illustrationScene: Above the reef, the last warm sunlight fades into a calm lavender-blue glow.
pages.continuityNotes: Near edge of sandy clearing; light dims.

pages.text: From a quiet sandy clearing, they listened as the bubbles, coral, and pebbles made one sleepy song.
pages.illustrationScene: From a quiet sandy clearing, they listen as bubbles, coral, and pebbles make one sleepy song.
pages.continuityNotes: Same sandy clearing; listening to reef song.

pages.text: Ebi gave a tiny yawn, and Corin felt his own eyes growing wonderfully heavy.
pages.illustrationScene: Ebi yawns and Corin feels his eyes growing wonderfully heavy in the same clearing.
pages.continuityNotes: Same clearing; sleepy but still present.

pages.text: Side by side, they followed the familiar sea-grass path back to Corin's coral nook.
pages.illustrationScene: Side by side they follow the familiar sea-grass path back toward Corin's coral nook.
pages.continuityNotes: Homeward on sea-grass path; peach-pink arch ahead.

pages.text: Beside the nook, Ebi nestled into her small fan-shaped sea-grass bed while Corin curled his tail around a soft coral stem.
pages.illustrationScene: At home, Ebi nestles in her right sea-grass bed while Corin curls his tail around a left coral stem.
pages.continuityNotes: Home nook: Corin LEFT on coral stem, Ebi RIGHT in sea-grass bed; awake/drowsy.

pages.text: In the deep-blue hush, the reef kept humming its gentle lullaby as both friends closed their eyes.
pages.illustrationScene: In the deep-blue hush, both friends close their eyes as the reef hums a gentle lullaby.
pages.continuityNotes: Exact same LEFT/RIGHT arrangement; eyes closed.

pages.text: Beneath the quiet moonlit water, Corin and Ebi drifted peacefully to sleep, tucked close together in their cozy reef home.
pages.illustrationScene: Beneath quiet moonlit water, Corin and Ebi sleep peacefully tucked close in their cozy reef home.
pages.continuityNotes: Exact same nook; both fully asleep; peaceful ending.
